name: Ujiie Itsuki
source:
A second year that originally came from Suzushiro High. A lone wolf who's usually silent but has a secret belligerent side, and is very interested in Shiori's habilities.
Despite his rude character, he seems to come from a good background.

[Translated from [url=http://quinrose.com/game/sw/character.html]Official site[/url]]
